projectName: Split Liability Onboarding From Default Bank Link
description: Separate standard bank onboarding from liability-specific onboarding. Default Plaid Link should request transactions only, while Settings should expose a second intentional flow for credit and loan accounts that requests transactions plus liabilities.

timing.gatingCondition: Production Plaid onboarding feedback confirms NO_LIABILITY_ACCOUNTS friction in default flow.

principles: Optimize the default flow for successful household bank onboarding
Do not break or mutate existing linked Items
Credit and loan accounts remain first-class, but their onboarding should be intentional
Keep liability support available without making it mandatory for every institution
Preserve server-side secrets invariant — no Plaid tokens or internal product state leak to clients

techStack.plaid: Plaid Link token creation with product-specific requests
techStack.testing: node:test integration coverage for link token creation and settings flows

userStories.title: Default bank onboarding requests transactions only
acceptanceCriteria: Default POST /api/link/create-token path requests only the Plaid Transactions product
Existing Item update mode remains supported
No existing linked Item is modified when this change ships
Default checking/savings onboarding no longer requires liability account consent
userStories.testStrategy: Route-level integration test verifying default link token request omits liabilities by default. Manual production verification with institution containing mixed depository and liability accounts.

userStories.title: Dedicated credit and loan onboarding flow
acceptanceCriteria: Settings page exposes a second button for linking credit / loan accounts
New server route creates a Plaid Link token with products ['transactions', 'liabilities']
Default and liability-specific onboarding flows are clearly labeled
Liability-specific flow reuses existing exchange and sync logic after successful link
userStories.testStrategy: Manual UI verification in Settings. Route test confirming liability-specific token includes liabilities. Smoke test that linked credit account still appears under normal account views after exchange.

userStories.title: Documentation and launch guidance
acceptanceCriteria: README or operator docs explain why default link is transactions-only
Docs explain when to use the credit / loan link path
Docs note that existing Items linked with liabilities remain unchanged
Future enhancement note added for account_filters if institution-specific tuning becomes necessary

high: Default flow change could accidentally remove needed credit-card onboarding if the liability-specific replacement is not shipped promptly
medium: Institution-specific behavior may still require account_filters or update-mode tuning later
Users may not understand which of the two link buttons to choose without clear labeling
low: Existing backend liabilities code may remain underused until the dedicated flow is exercised

preFlightChecklist: Confirm default onboarding should optimize for depository success over liability completeness
Confirm credit-card transaction visibility still matters even when liability metadata is optional
Confirm existing linked Items must remain untouched
